name: Multiattack (Mythic)
body:
This creature’s natural weapon attacks possess an unearthly grace and ferocity.

Prerequisite(s): Multiattack.

Benefit(s): The creature’s secondary attacks with natural weapons are treated as primary attacks. Additionally, if the creature successfully strikes the same opponent with all of its natural weapon attacks in the same round, it can expend two uses of mythic power as part of the attack to rend its opponent for an additional 1d4 points of damage for each mythic rank the attacking creature possesses.

Normal: Without this mythic feat, the creature’s secondary attacks with natural weapons take a –2 penalty.
